notes: Weights sum to 100, so a factor's contribution is in score points. Normalisation is linear between floor and cap, clipped to [0, 1].

hard_brake_rate.unit: hard brakes + near misses per 100 km
hard_brake_rate.description: Frequency of detected hard-braking and near-miss incidents

speeding_share.description: Share of moving time more than 5% over the posted limit

phone_moving_s.description: Seconds of phone screen use while moving (from phone_distraction incidents)

night_share.description: Share of GPS samples between 22:00 and 05:00 UTC

crash.description: Whether a crash incident was detected
